1) Goal: Find the brand(s) of products that have exactly 3 units left.
2) KB helper functions available: export_customers_csv_via_grid and export_orders_csv. Neither targets the product/catalog grid or inventory data, so they are not applicable. Therefore I do not call any KB functions.
3) From the current storefront state, the deterministic way to reach the product management grid is to navigate to the relative admin path '/index.php/admin/catalog/product/'. The code uses a relative page.goto to do this.
4) Once on the page, the function enumerates accessible tables (role='table') and reads their inner_text. It normalizes NBSPs and tokenizes columns by tabs or runs of 2+ spaces to accommodate Magento accessibility spacing quirks.

6) The function prints each found brand on its own line and returns the list. No language changes are made and no KB helpers are used.
